proposed_comments.title: Preserve the timer creation error
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the timer creation error

**Severity:** `medium`

The recording timer is the probe's stopping mechanism. Its failure guard needs the error from `SetTimer`, but this declaration does not preserve that native error. Add `SetLastError = true` together with the timer creation and cleanup change below.

```suggestion
    [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)] static extern UIntPtr SetTimer(IntPtr hwnd, UIntPtr id, uint elapse, IntPtr proc);
```

confidence.rationale: Exact current source and caller counterevidence assessed; conditional failure behavior checked without invoking desktop APIs, and literal candidate parsing/embedded C# compilation verified.

proposed_comments.title: Allow a screenshot filename in the current directory
proposed_comments.body:
### Allow a screenshot filename in the current directory

**Severity:** `medium`

For `-OutputPath desktop.png`, `Split-Path -Parent` is empty, so `New-Item` fails before the bitmap is saved. Create a parent directory only when one is present; leave the supplied filename unchanged so the PNG is saved in the current directory.

```suggestion
    $outputDirectory = Split-Path -Path $OutputPath -Parent
    if ($outputDirectory) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $outputDirectory -Force | Out-Null
    }
```

proposed_comments.title: Allow a mouse recording filename in the current directory
proposed_comments.body:
### Allow a mouse recording filename in the current directory

**Severity:** `medium`

For `-OutputPath hook.csv`, the parent path is empty and unconditional directory creation fails before `Export-Csv`. Skip directory creation for a leaf filename while retaining it for nested output paths. This does not change how an empty recording is enumerated.

```suggestion
$outputDirectory = Split-Path -Path $OutputPath -Parent
if ($outputDirectory) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $outputDirectory -Force | Out-Null
}
```

proposed_comments.title: Reject a failed acceleration read
proposed_comments.body:
### Reject a failed acceleration read

**Severity:** `low`

The SET calls in `Apply` check their return values, but this GET call does not. If the read fails, the zero-initialized array is reported as observed acceleration-off settings. Check the BOOL result and throw the captured native error before returning diagnostic data.

```suggestion
        if (!SystemParametersInfo(SPI_GETMOUSE, 0, values, 0))
            throw new System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error());
```

confidence.rationale: The exact GET method returns initialized defaults on a false BOOL; managed failure seams demonstrate upstream defaults versus candidate exceptions and preserve successful reads.

proposed_comments.title: Reject a failed pointer speed read
proposed_comments.body:
### Reject a failed pointer speed read

**Severity:** `low`

The SET calls in `Apply` check their return values, but this GET call does not. If the read fails, the zero-initialized speed is reported as an observed value. Check the BOOL result and throw the captured native error before returning diagnostic data.

```suggestion
        if (!SystemParametersInfo(SPI_GETMOUSESPEED, 0, ref speed, 0))
            throw new System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error());
```
